notes: Site kavehome.com/es/en/ is a Next.js storefront (locale /es/en/, lang=en-ES, renders fully in English -- no translation needed). Accessed via direct HTTP (curl_cffi, impersonate=chrome131); each category/selection page server-renders an embedded Algolia InstantSearch payload (appId EQ79XLPIU7) with nbHits/hitsPerPage/nbPages, which was used as the qty source and cross-checked (ceil(nbHits/96)==nbPages) same as the prior Home-Decor pass. robots.txt has no Claude/anthropic-ai disallow and references selection-sitemap.xml -> https://kavehome.com/es/en/selections-sitemap.xml (423 URLs), which is Kave Home's own curated-listing index ('/s/<slug>' pages, filter type pages.selections:<slug>_<id>, distinct from ordinary '/o/<slug>' category pages which use pages.categories:<slug>). Searched that sitemap plus the homepage nav/i18n payload for bestseller-type terms. Found 3 genuine, currently-live Bestsellers PLPs, each a real product grid with its own Algolia selection id (not aliases of each other -- different nbHits and different selection ids): 'Bestsellers' (selection id bestsellers_15594, 160 products) and 'Best sellers' (selection id best-sellers_15468, 79 products) are two separate top-level bestseller-concept listings with no shared parent hub page found; 'Outdoor Best Sellers Team' (selection id ...None_15567, 15 products) is a room-scoped bestseller sub-listing, kept as its own row since no formal Bestsellers hub groups them (so none are marked is_group). No other bestseller/top-seller/most-popular/trending/customer-favorite selections were found in the sitemap (grepped for best/top-sell/popular/trending/favou?r -- only 'favourites/favorites' hits were personal-curator 'X's favourites' editorial picks, e.g. /s/cristinas-favourites, /s/eleonora-carisis-favorites -- these are influencer/staff editorial picks, not a site-wide bestseller concept, so excluded per PLP-vs-editorial rule.
